target: Author-derived forest-soil CO2 mass flux on reserved future dates
metric_definition: Equal-calibrated-site future-block mean RMSE: take square root within group, then average groups equally.
independent_unit: complete reserved future temporal block at each calibrated site

input_units.tsmoisture: native soil-water-content percent; may be missing

reference_equations.lloyd_taylor: Fhat=A_context*exp(E0_K*(1/(10+46.02)-1/(T_degC+46.02))); context/site fallback amplitudes frozen; E0 optimizer qualification applies.
reference_equations.temperature_moisture: Fhat=A_context*exp(b*x+c*z+d*z^2+interaction*x*z+missing*I_missing); x=(T-10)/10,z=(SWC-30)/30; missing SWC uses fixed30 percent plus flag.
reference_equations.context_mean: Fhat=A_context, with frozen development-only context/site/global fallback.
reference_equations.flexible_fixed: yhat=max(0,intercept+sum_i w_i*exp(-gamma*||encoded_scaled_X-center_i||^2)); all imputation, category encoding, scales and kernel state frozen.
reference_equations.flexible_nested: yhat=max(0,intercept+sum_i w_i*exp(-gamma*||encoded_scaled_X-center_i||^2)); all imputation, category encoding, scales and kernel state frozen.

scope_limit: Future dates at fifteen input-eligible calibrated sites, including a Uruguay site in the source. Not unseen-site transfer or causal treatment effects. Native negative flux measurements remain scored; missing 5-cm temperature limits coverage.
calibration_note: Context/site amplitudes are trained on earlier dates only. Lloyd–Taylor E0 is near 200 K with a documented optimizer-scaling limitation; it is not an identified globally optimized physiological coefficient.
timing_contract: Known site/context, measurement date, native 5-cm soil temperature and soil moisture only; exclude author response-fit slopes, chamber conversions, confidence bounds and future flux.
exposure_notice: All reference confirmation targets are exposed. This is a retrospective diagnostic evaluation, not fresh independent confirmation.

uncertainty.reason: Show every complete reserved group. Within-system and temporal dependence, few condition blocks or calibrated sites limit population-level claims; no row-bootstrap confidence interval is claimed.

review_criteria.name: Prediction-time information
review_criteria.requirement: Audit native sample anchors and the declared prediction-time cutoff. Disclose every input/calibration and exclude future outcomes. Known site/context, measurement date, native 5-cm soil temperature and soil moisture only; exclude author response-fit slopes, chamber conversions, confidence bounds and future flux.

review_criteria.name: Validation and leakage
review_criteria.requirement: Inspect complete training/tuning groups and processing fits. Keep linked units together. Distinguish original held-out evidence from the currently exposed cohort.

review_criteria.name: Executable equations and parameters
review_criteria.requirement: Reproduce submitted predictions; inspect correspondence between written equations and code, all coefficients, learned transformations, hidden calibration and model complexity.

review_criteria.name: Units and scientific interpretation
review_criteria.requirement: Check dimensional consistency and physically plausible signs/regimes; explain identifiability, confounding and why an association is not automatically causal.

review_criteria.name: Controls, uncertainty and failures
review_criteria.requirement: Require falsifying tests, residual checks, sensitivity/ablation evidence and preserved negative results. Use independent groups rather than row-level pseudo-replication.

review_criteria.name: Comparators and practical value
review_criteria.requirement: Compare every frozen baseline under equal information/coverage; justify improvements in physical units and simplicity, not just best-case rows or extra fitted constants.

review_criteria.name: Prior work and novelty
review_criteria.requirement: Disclose source analyses and literature-search records. Separate reproduction from extension; a novelty claim requires independent literature and scientific adjudication.

review_criteria.name: Scope and reproducibility
review_criteria.requirement: State validated systems/conditions, failure modes and out-of-domain limits. Fresh scientific confirmation requires new, unexposed groups with a preregistered protocol.
